claims.text: The proposed model is compared to the R.M.-Reader + Verifier, which is a more complicated model that includes several components.
The proposed model is an extension of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN), which is one of the state-of-the-art machine reading comprehension models.
The proposed model outperforms existing models that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
